item.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Learn the core concepts of data engineering including ETL pipelines, data warehousing, and best practices for building scalable data systems.
item.content:encoded:
Data engineering is the practice of designing and building systems for collecting, storing, and analyzing data. In this comprehensive guide, we explore:

  • ETL vs ELT paradigms
  • Data warehouse architecture
  • Real-time vs batch processing
  • Best practices and tools

Read the full article on our blog for detailed code examples and best practices.

item.title: Building Scalable Data Pipelines
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Learn how to design and implement data pipelines that scale from thousands to millions of records using Apache Airflow, Spark, and modern data stack tools.
item.content:encoded:
Building scalable data pipelines is essential for modern data organizations. This guide covers:

  • Orchestration with Apache Airflow
  • Distributed processing with Spark
  • Monitoring and alerting
  • Cost optimization strategies

Includes practical examples and code snippets for immediate implementation.

item.title: Real-Time Analytics with Kafka and ClickHouse
item.author: Victor Kipruto Rop
item.description: Explore how to build real-time analytics systems using Apache Kafka for streaming ingestion and ClickHouse for sub-second query performance on massive datasets.
item.content:encoded:
Real-time analytics enables organizations to make decisions based on current data. Learn how to:

  • Set up Kafka clusters for high-throughput streaming
  • Configure ClickHouse for real-time analytics
  • Build resilient data pipelines
  • Monitor system performance

Complete with architecture diagrams and production-ready configurations.
